title: Reflected XSS — single-quoted JS string breakout inside <script>
remediation: Context-aware output encoding is the primary fix: HTML-entity-encode in HTML text context, attribute-encode (and always quote attributes) in attribute context, JavaScript/JSON-encode in script context, and allowlist URL schemes (reject javascript:) in URL context. Never build markup by concatenating untrusted data. Prefer a framework that auto-escapes per context, and deploy a strict Content-Security-Policy (no unsafe-inline, nonce/hash script sources) as defense-in-depth so a residual injection cannot execute.
